name: archon-panel
description: An Archon pane in the side panel: workflow runs and the progress of their nodes, refreshed while a run is going.

archonPath.title: Archon command
archonPath.description: The Archon CLI to run; the default finds it on your PATH.

limit.title: Most runs listed
limit.description: How many recent runs to list (1-50).

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often to refresh while the pane is shown (2-300); 0 refreshes only on open, after turns and on r.
